question.:question/problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
a_1=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 5 \\ -2\end{bmatrix},\quad a_2=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 6 \\ -2\end{bmatrix},\quad a_3=\begin{bmatrix}-1 \\ -8 \\ 2\end{bmatrix},\quad b=\begin{bmatrix}9 \\ 9 \\ 0\end{bmatrix}
$$

If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b,$ then what is $x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}x_1\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 5 \\ -2\end{bmatrix}+x_2\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 6 \\ -2\end{bmatrix}+x_3\begin{bmatrix}-1 \\ -8 \\ 2\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}9 \\ 9 \\ 0\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} \\ 5 x_{1} \\ - 2 x_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}x_{2} \\ 6 x_{2} \\ - 2 x_{2}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}- x_{3} \\ - 8 x_{3} \\ 2 x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}9 \\ 9 \\ 0\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} + x_{2} - x_{3} \\ 5 x_{1} + 6 x_{2} - 8 x_{3} \\ - 2 x_{1} - 2 x_{2} + 2 x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}9 \\ 9 \\ 0\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} + x_{2} - x_{3} &=9 \\ 5 x_{1} + 6 x_{2} - 8 x_{3} &=9 \\ - 2 x_{1} - 2 x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &=0\end{aligned}\right.
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & -1 & 9 \\ 5 & 6 & -8 & 9 \\ -2 & -2 & 2 & 0\end{array}\right]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M&=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & -1 & 9 \\ 5 & 6 & -8 & 9 \\ -2 & -2 & 2 & 0\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & -1 & 9 \\ 0 & 1 & -3 & -36 \\ -2 & -2 & 2 & 0\end{array}\right] && R_{2}:=R_{2}+(-5)R_{1} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & -1 & 9 \\ 0 & 1 & -3 & -36 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 18\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(2)R_{1}\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} + x_{2} - x_{3} &=9 \\ x_{2} - 3 x_{3} &=-36 \\ 0 &=18\end{aligned}\right.
$$

However, the final equation $0=18$ gives a false statement. So the system has no solution.
